semantics.llm_context_columns: raw passing and duplicates removed before survival; repeated once per included record/timepoint in pooled rows
semantics.absent: excluded from denominator; included in population_total and absent column
semantics.days: fixed points grouped at 0; other points use exact elapsed 24-hour days rounded to 9 decimals from timeline
semantics.day_ranges: 0 = fixed version regardless of actual gap; nonfixed exact gaps use (0,30], (30,180], (180,365], (365,730], (730,infinity); no rounding
semantics.dev_own: filter dev rows where own_class is true
semantics.compile_categories: affected method counts (may overlap); separate raw diagnostic counts per failed file
semantics.class_2x2: only present CUT pairs with nonempty populations; every status except pass is nonpass
